Cornetist Jim Cullum is one of the most recognized artists in traditional jazz.

He has directed the Jim Cullum Jazz Band since 1973 and appears with this group on the high profile radio show “Riverwalk, Live from the Landing.” They have recorded 45 albums and Jim has played an important role in keeping American music of the early twentieth century alive.
Jim was interviewed in New York City on January 12, 2007 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Manhattan filming at the IAJE. I’m really pleased to have Jim Cullum with me today, trumpet player and band leader, and I think really has significantly made a big measure with your marketing too, your marketing team. You guys are out there.
I really, I’m impressed by how much exposure you’re getting on the internet and all that and with the radio show and everything. So you’re doing good stuff.
